_doc: Declarative source of truth for hero innate stat bonuses. Used by builders/heroes_stats.py (level-1 seeding) and src/scripts.js (per-level recompute on the heroes-stats table). Stage 1 of innate centralization — do not edit without verifying against KV files in data/stats/<patch>/heroes/.

_formula_types.self_attr_pct_per_level: bonus = attrs[target] * (base_pct + per_level_pct * level)  -- self-referential, target==source
_formula_types.hp_pct: bonus = current_hp * factor / 100  (current_hp includes str scaling)
_formula_types.mana_pool_pct_per_level: bonus = current_mp * (base_pct + per_level_pct * level)  (current_mp includes int scaling)
_formula_types.ms_multiplier: multiplier = 1 + (base_pct + per_level_pct * level) / 100  (a % move-speed bonus: scales base MS + flat MS bonuses; adds to item % move-speed bonuses)
_formula_types.armor_factor: bonus = (armor_base + agi * ARMOR_PER_AGI) * factor  (armor_base = ArmorPhysical KV field)
_formula_types.secondary_attr_factor: bonus = derived_stat_from_attr * factor  (hpr: STR*HPREG_PER_STR; mpr: INT*MANAREG_PER_INT; aspd: AGI*AS_PER_AGI; armor: AGI*ARMOR_PER_AGI; mr: INT*MR_PER_INT)
_formula_types.dmg_universal_bonus_pct: universal_dmg_mult *= (1 + factor)  (applied inside primary-damage calc, only for Universal heroes)
_formula_types.attr_substitution: replaces the attribute used to derive target stat (Ogre: STR derives MP and MPR instead of INT)
_formula_types.mana_shield_ehp: ehp_bonus = current_mp * absorb_pct * damage_per_mana  (damage absorbed by spending mana; dpm scales with level)
_formula_types.bonus_ms_factor: bonus = bonus_ms * (base + per_level * level) / 100  (armor from move speed above base; Elder Titan)
_formula_types.flat_per_level_interval: bonus = value * max(0, floor((level - offset) / interval))  (a fixed bonus granted every `interval` levels, e.g. every even level: interval=2, offset=0)
_formula_types.regen_amp_pct: regen *= 1 + factor / 100  (amplifies the whole regen of the target type; adds to item regen amplification)

effects.note: KV strength_to_movement_pct. Since the 7.41 rework the bonus does not stack with boots (tooltip: 'does not stack with bonuses from boots') — Hero Lab uses max(horsepower, boots MS) when stacks_with_boots is false. Earlier patches not verified; treated as stacking.

KV movement_speed_pct (7.41a+: value=base_pct, hero_levelup=per_level_pct; 7.36-7.40c: movement_speed_pct_per_level). 7.40 note '0.75% + 0.75% per level up' = 0.75% * level, so base_pct is 0 there. Python applies it in _ms_l1() via _innate_mult(); JS via innateMult()/heroLabInnatePct(). The 7.40 entry runs to 7.41 because the 7.41 KV snapshot is identical to 7.40c (the 7.41 change is visible from 7.41a).

Spell cooldown reduction %. KV cooldown_reduction_pct hero_levelup=+0.75 (7.36-7.40c: cooldown_reduction_pct_per_level). 7.36: 0.5%/level; 7.38: 0.75%/level; 7.40 '0.75% + 0.75% per level up' and 7.41 '0.75% per level' are the same effective value. Hero Lab only (Cooldown Reduction row) — combined multiplicatively with item CDR.

Momentum: armor = factor% of BONUS movement speed (MS above base — starting/base MS is the reference and does NOT count). factor = base + per_level * level and SCALES with hero level: KV value=base, hero_levelup=per_level, and per the 7.41 innate rework the increment is provided at level 1 (so level-1 factor = base + per_level, e.g. 7.0+0.5=7.5% in 7.41e). hero_lab: applied in calc() via elderTitanMomentumArmor() AFTER ms is known — NOT the generic innate() dispatch (which runs before MS). Hero Stats table: Python _innate_bonus() bonus_ms_factor branch reads above-base (innate) MS at level 1; Elder Titan has no innate MS, so it is 0 there. Pre-7.41a Momentum granted attack speed from bonus MS instead; intentionally not modeled.
Self-referential: bonus agi is folded into her agi so all agi-derived stats (dmg, armor, aspd) pick it up. KV value=10, hero_levelup=+1 (both in percent /100).
KV intelligence_per_speed=N; factor = 1/N.
KV attack_speed_bonus.hero_levelup=+4 (no base value). KV also has movement_speed_bonus.hero_levelup=+0.3 but this is not modeled by design.
KV hero_levelup=+2 (damage). Handled in JS innateDmg(); not yet in Python _innate_bonus().
KV value=225, hero_levelup=+25. Night Vision is not a displayed column in heroes_stats table — included for completeness.

98% of incoming damage is absorbed by mana at a cost of damage_per_mana. KV absorption_pct=98, damage_per_mana=2 + hero_levelup=+0.1 (since 7.41a). Handled in JS manaShieldEhp() and medusaDpm(); already added to ehpPhys in calc().
KV attack_range_per_agi (percent /100).
KV move_speed_per_agi=15 (percent /100). Unchanged since 7.41.
KV cast_range_per_str (flat cast range /100). Introduced 7.41a.
KV slow_resist_per_str (percent /100). Introduced 7.41a.
Self-inclusive innate: the bonus applies to Naga Siren herself, so the base evasion is always active and scales further with additional nearby Nagas/illusions.
Ogre uses STR * 6 for MP instead of INT * 12. OGRE_MANA_PER_STR=6.0.
Ogre uses STR * 0.02 for Mana Regen instead of INT * 0.05. OGRE_MANAREG_PER_STR=0.02.
A PERCENT move-speed bonus, not flat: KV movespeed_pct hero_levelup=+1 (7.36-7.41: movespeed_per_level_pct=1), tooltip '%MOVEMENT SPEED:', 7.36 note 'Increases movement speed by 1% per level'.
KV value=0.08, hero_levelup=0.02. Handled in JS innateDmg(); not yet in Python _innate_bonus(). Note: sven_vanquisher (value=20) is a separate innate for Great Cleave — not a stat modifier.
KV bonus_mana_as_mana_regen: value in percent /100, hero_levelup in percent /100. Handled in Python via _techies_pool_regen_l1(); not in the standard _innate_bonus() dispatch.

KV value=1.75 (percent, 7.41f; 1.25 in 7.39d-7.41e). Leveled phase 7.37b-7.39c: 1.2/1.3/1.4/1.5 per rank — Python/JS both use max rank (1.5) for that window. Handled in JS innateDmg(); Python uses _innate_bonus() with StatusHealth base.
bonus_hpr = STR * HPREG_PER_STR * factor
bonus_mpr = INT * MANAREG_PER_INT * factor
bonus_aspd = AGI * AS_PER_AGI * factor
bonus_armor = AGI * ARMOR_PER_AGI * factor. Removed in 7.41.
bonus_mr = INT * MR_PER_INT * factor. Removed in 7.41.

KV damage_stat_bonus_pct=15. Multiplies the universal attribute-to-damage multiplier: mult *= 1.15. Only applies because VS is a Universal hero. Embedded in _primary_dmg() in Python and primaryDmg() in JS — not in innate() dispatch.

KV curiosity_per_level=1 stack per hero level x curiosity_attack_damage=1 base damage (tooltip: '1 stack of Curiosity per level that grants him 1 base damage'); per the 7.41 rule the increment is granted at level 1. Temporary (spell-cast) and kill stacks are not modelled. New in 7.41 — gated at 7.41a because the 7.41 KV snapshot equals 7.40c.

KV fish_health_bonus=3 per fish. Tidehunter eats a free fish every even hero level (tooltip; 7.41b 'Now gains fish on every even level instead of every level'). 7.41/7.41a: a fish on every level-up (modelled as level-1 fish). Enemy-kill fish not modelled.

KV fish_attack_range=2 per fish. Tidehunter eats a free fish every even hero level (tooltip; 7.41b 'Now gains fish on every even level instead of every level'). 7.41/7.41a: a fish on every level-up (modelled as level-1 fish). Enemy-kill fish not modelled.

KV hp_regen_amp=20, always on since the 7.41 rework. hp_regen_amp_out_of_world=100 (while untargetable/invulnerable) is not modelled; 7.36-7.40c Pixie Dust (+100%/+150%) only worked while untargetable/hidden, so it is not modelled either.
KV mana_regen_amp=20 (see hpr note).
KV slow_resistance value=24, hero_levelup=1 (7.41 note '24% + 1% per level'). 7.37b-7.40c: 20/30/40/50% by Reverse Polarity rank — not modelled. Hero Lab only.
KV vampiric_aura value + hero_levelup. Before 7.41 it levelled with Reincarnation rank — not modelled. Hero Lab only.
KV base_slow_resist=10, slow_resistance_per_threshold=1, hp_per_threshold=100 (per 100 Max Health). Pre-7.41 Colossal only gave building damage. Hero Lab only.
